description: This file defines the Ext.ux.menu.RangeMenu class, a custom extension of Ext.menu.Menu for filtering with range options (gt, lt, eq) in Ext JS 3.3.0, including methods for managing filter values and handling input events.

classes.name: Ext.ux.menu.RangeMenu
classes.description: A custom menu component for range filtering with gt, lt, eq options, extending Ext.menu.Menu.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the RangeMenu, sets up event handling, and creates range filter input fields.

methods.name: fireUpdate
methods.description: Triggers the 'update' event to notify that filter configuration has changed.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current filter values from the input fields.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the filter input fields' values and fires the 'update' event.

methods.name: onInputKeyUp
methods.description: Handles keyup events on input fields, manages filter logic, and restarts update timer.
